answer: Agents post reputation collateral priced in real compute: to register a new identity, an agent must burn GPU cycles proving sustained useful work, measured against a ridge of historical performance benchmarks. A sybil farm must therefore pay full compute cost per fake identity, and any identity caught faking gets its stake slashed to zero. Verified agents also cross-attest one another like raven calls warning of intrusion, so a cluster of fresh identities with no shale of accumulated compute history is flagged and quarantined before it can vote or earn.
